0022600127.text: The Nuggets (1-1, 1-0 at home, on a W1 streak) host the Warriors (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) in Denver's third game of the season, with Denver 4th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, and Golden State 4th in the Pacific, 3 games back. Denver's unavailable players are Alpha Diallo (wrist), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring) (all out), while Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery) (all out), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The 2025-26 season series between the teams was split 2-2, with Denver winning the last meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
